job.title: Professional Software Developer m/w/d Kotlin/Java
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Your high-volume online printing business needs robust JVM backends – I have built Java and Spring backends for large e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell for 5+ years.

– Developed OCC REST web services (headless APIs) for storefronts, PWA frontends and third-party consumers
– Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed
– Engineered API migrations for customer account structures, improving stability and data consistency
– Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2)

I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. Would you have 15 minutes for a short call in the coming days? My CV and cover letter are attached.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Professional Software Developer | Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs & Microservices
tailoring.summary: Professional software developer with 5+ years of Java development on large enterprise e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java (Core & J2EE), Spring and Spring Boot, microservices, RESTful APIs, SQL and query performance tuning. Builds automated tests with JUnit, works with Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker and Kubernetes and supports production troubleshooting. Experienced with product, catalog, pricing and order logic in high-volume online commerce. Performs code reviews, uses AI-assisted development daily and works in agile, international teams.
tailoring.why_company: flyeralarm is one of Europe's leading online printers, with a self-built e-commerce and production platform handling huge order volumes. I want to apply five years of Java and Spring backend work on large e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell – APIs, performance tuning, testing – to software that drives such a large online business.

en.subject: Application: Professional Software Developer Kotlin/Java
en.hook: flyeralarm runs one of Europe's largest online printing businesses, where robust JVM backends carry high order volumes every day. For more than five years I have built exactly that kind of software: Java and Spring backends for large enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell.

bullets.label: Java & Spring backend development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend functionality with Java and Spring for product, catalog, pricing and customer data, following design patterns and best practices.

bullets.label: APIs & services
bullets.text: Built RESTful APIs and web services for headless and PWA frontends; consumed and exposed REST and SOAP services and engineered API migrations for customer account structures.

bullets.label: Performance & quality
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed; built automated unit and integration tests with JUnit and performed code reviews.

bullets.label: Delivery
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds within agile DevOps workflows and supported production troubleshooting.

en.logistics: My JVM foundation makes me productive in a Kotlin/Java codebase, and I use AI tools daily to move faster. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would welcome a conversation with your team in Würzburg.
